CONTEMPORARY A-FRAME — NORDIC VERNACULAR

Lima Cabin

A single roof, drawn all the way to the ground.

Lima reduces the house to one gesture: a glulam A-frame that touches the forest floor on both sides and opens, at its north end, into a wall of triangulated glass.
